description: Gradium Q8 speech model for English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese with a bundled default voice (CC BY-NC 4.0)

releaseNotes.releaseNotes: Adds seven offline preset voices alongside the preserved Marlowe preset: Maeve and Toby (UK English), Zoey, Harper, and Easton (US English), Noémie (French), and Anton (German). Anton is the new default voice; explicitly selected voices are preserved. Voice assets and catalog metadata are pinned to gradium/phonon-voices revision 0ee17205f254b5abc43b266c8a0f215565c352f7 and distributed under Apache-2.0. Model weights and their CC BY-NC 4.0 license are unchanged. Requires xn-ptts 0.1.5 or newer.
